    currency: "MAD",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(n);

// ─── Normalised card type accepted by ProductCard / ProductRail ───────────────
export type CardProduct = {
  preorder_enabled?: boolean;
  preorder_estimated_at?: string | null;
  preorder_message?: string | null;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  subCategory?: string;
  price: number;
  oldPrice?: number;
  image: string;
  colors: string[];
  sizes: string[];
  badge?: string;
  rating?: number;
  reviewCount?: number;
  createdAt?: string;
  /** Live database inventory. Undefined is reserved for static fallback products. */
  stock?: number;
};

/** Convert an API/Supabase product to the CardProduct format */
export function apiToCard(p: {
  preorder_enabled?: boolean;
  preorder_estimated_at?: string | null;
  preorder_message?: string | null;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number;
  original_price?: number | null;
  images?: string[] | null;
  colors?: string[] | null;
  sizes?: string[] | null;
  featured?: boolean;
  created_at?: string;
  brand?: string | null;
  stock?: number | null;
}): CardProduct {
  return {
    slug: p.slug,
    name: p.name,
    category: p.category,
    price: p.price,
    oldPrice: p.original_price ?? undefined,
    image:
      (p.images ?? []).find((url) => !!url) ??
      "/images/placeholder.png",
    colors: (p.colors as string[]) ?? [],
    sizes: (p.sizes as string[]) ?? [],
    badge: p.featured && isNewArrivalEligible(p) ? "Nouveau" : undefined,
    createdAt: p.created_at,
    preorder_enabled: p.preorder_enabled === true,
    preorder_estimated_at: p.preorder_estimated_at ?? null,
    preorder_message: p.preorder_message ?? null,
    stock: typeof p.stock === "number" ? p.stock : undefined,
  };
}

/** Catalogue items excluded from the curated new-arrivals selection. */
export function isNewArrivalEligible(product: { slug: string; name: string; brand?: string | null }): boolean {
  const identity = `${product.brand ?? ""} ${product.slug} ${product.name}`;
  return !/\blenovo\b|\bstronger[\s-]+with[\s-]+you\b/i.test(identity);
}
